title: Restriction comparison for the canonical relative Proj
statement: For a finite type quasi-coherent module E on a scheme S and an affine open U, the relative Proj of E restricted to U is canonically isomorphic over U to the restriction of the canonical relative Proj of E.

proof.text: For an affine open V of U, the sections of E|_U over V are those of E over the image of V, so the canonical graded algebra of Sym(E|_U) agrees on V with that of Sym(E), compatibly with restrictions. Both relative Proj schemes are glued from the charts Proj(Sym(E)(V)) along the same transitions, and over affine V the preimage of V in the global relative Proj is this chart; the chart embeddings glue to an isomorphism over U, which commutes with the structural morphisms chart by chart.
